verdict.rationale: Exa's Websets product is explicitly designed for bulk operations — searching, verifying, and enriching many items at once, including async list-building and webhook callbacks as items are processed (exa-docs-7, exa-docs-8, exa-docs-9, exa-docs-15, exa-docs-21). However, hands-on community testing found this bulk enrichment did not reliably work — enrichment columns failed to return requested data (e.g., sale price) and searches got stuck 'Verifying...' for many items without completing (exa-comm-2, exa-comm-3), directly contradicting the vendor's claim of reliably verifying/enriching 'every match'. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that bulk verify/enrich works at scale, resolution of the observed stuck/incomplete-enrichment failures.
